 Effective July 30, 2026, the New Selection Program (2026) launches with increased benefits to help you launch new branded products with reduced costs and complexity while boosting early sales.
 Hello,
 If you’re currently enrolled in our existing New Selection Program , you’ll automatically receive New Selection Program (2026) benefits for new branded FBA ASINs that launch starting July 30, through October 31, 2026, as an introductory offer.
 To continue to receive New Selection Program (2026) benefits after October 31, you must confirm your enrollment on Enroll in New Selection Program (2026) . From July 30, the existing New Selection Program will end.
New benefits for an eligible new-to-FBA product include (applicable from first inventory received date):
- Instant fee credits equivalent to capping referral fees to 10% (or your existing rate, whichever is lower) on your first 100 units and 5% (or your existing rate, whichever is lower) on the next 100 units. Credits apply to major fees, like referral and fulfillment fees.
- $50 in coupon variable fee credits and $75 in Vine enrollment fee credits (applied to middle tier), usable within the first 60 days.
- Free storage, free customer returns, free liquidations on your first 200 units for the first 120 days.
- No low-inventory-level fee and storage utilization surcharge on your first 200 units for the first 120 days.
- 45-day extension on the above benefits when using the Vine Pre-launch service . Note : New Selection Program (2026) benefits don’t stack with New Seller Incentives. If eligible for both, New Seller Incentives benefits will be applied first.
 For more information, go to New Selection Program (2026) .

 ASIN: B0H41KG8WJ
 Amazon requires you to demonstrate your Children's toys listed on Amazon Canada complies with applicable laws, regulations, standards and Amazon policies.
In order to sell Children's toys you must meet the requirements listed on the Children's toys help page , and work with one of our partner third-party testing, inspection and certification (TIC) service providers to verify that your product complies with these requirements.
 A children’s toy is a product intended for use in learning or play by a child 13 years of age or younger.
Toys are determined to be children’s toys based on the following criteria:
Age grading on the product packaging is intended for use by a child 13 years of age or younger.
Product is represented in its packaging, display, promotion or advertising as appropriate for use by a child 13 years of age or younger.
Product is commonly recognized by consumers as being intended for use by a child 13 years of age or younger.

subject: New EU restriction on textile and footwear disposal
body_preview:
96
 By July 19, update your removal settings for apparel, clothing and footwear in EU fulfillment centers
 Hello,
Starting July 19, 2026 , new EU requirements under the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) will restrict the destruction of certain unsold products, including apparel, clothing accessories, and footwear.
 With this change, you may incur a fine for the disposal of these products in line with local country requirements, based on your business size and disposal volume.
If you sell textiles or footwear in the EU, we recommend that you update your FBA removal settings to Return, Liquidate, or Donate (where eligible) before July 19, 2026.
To review removal options and eligibility, go to Remove Inventory from a Fulfillment Center .
 Note: Products that aren’t eligible for donation or liquidation may require disposal in line with relevant regulations and safety guidelines. This may impact your ESPR compliance status.
Also, on June 25, we’ll update the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) Donations terms and conditions in accordance with the above new requirement, our increased cross-border donation capabilities for inventory in Europe, and for program consistency.

Los productores deben pagar tarifas de contribución ecológica a las organizaciones de responsabilidad del productor (PRO) por las ventas de los productos sujetos a las obligaciones de la RAP en Amazon.es. Como se comunicó anteriormente, se te inscribió automáticamente en RAP - Pagamos en tu nombre de Amazon, y Amazon pagó las tarifas de contribución ecológica por tus ventas porque cumplías todos los criterios siguientes:

- Has vendido productos sujetos a las obligaciones de la RAP en España en Amazon.es en las categorías pertinentes.

96
 Invia la documentazione sulla sicurezza del prodotto per riattivare le offerte
 Gentile Weihai EU,
 Alcune delle tue offerte sono state disattivate a causa della mancanza di alcuni requisiti di conformità obbligatori per i tuoi prodotti. Rivedi i dettagli e i passi successivi riportati di seguito. Puoi visualizzare le offerte interessate in fondo a questa e-mail.
 Ciò a cosa è dovuto?
 Abbiamo intrapreso questo provvedimento in quanto i tuoi prodotti non dispongono delle informazioni obbligatorie sulla conformità. Consulta la pagina di aiuto Sicurezza e conformità dei prodotti per informazioni sulle leggi, le normative e le politiche di Amazon applicabili. Questa decisione è stata presa sulla base dei risultati di un'analisi effettuata in parte tramite revisione umana e in parte per mezzo di sistemi automatizzati.
 La tabella alla fine di questa e-mail contiene i requisiti di conformità specifici per i prodotti.
 Come faccio a riattivare le mie offerte?
 Per fornire le informazioni di conformità richieste, vai alla pagina Stato dell'account per individuare le richieste di conformità dei prodotti:
-
 Se disponi della documentazione richiesta, segui le istruzioni per inviare i documenti di conformità. Ripristineremo solo i prodotti che soddisfano i requisiti di conformità.
-
 Se ritieni che i tuoi prodotti siano esenti da questi requisiti, invia la documentazione che dimostra il motivo per cui non sono soggetti a questi requisiti di conformità.
 Per istruzioni dettagliate, consulta la pagina di aiuto Inviare documenti di conformità o contestare una richiesta relativa alla documentazione .
 Affinché il tuo account non venga compromesso ulteriormente, chiudi o elimina le offerte non conformi che non desideri ripristinare o per cui non intendi presentare una contestazione.
 Che cosa succede se non intraprendo le azioni sopra indicate?
 Se non fornisci le informazioni di conformità richieste, gli ASIN interessati rimarranno disattivati fino a quando le richieste di conformità non saranno gestite da te o da un altro partner di vendita che offre il prodotto.
 Cosa succede al mio inventario Logistica di Amazon relativo a questi prodotti?
 Devi rimuovere questi prodotti dai nostri centri logistici entro 30 giorni dalla data della presente notifica. In caso contrario, provvederemo a reimpiegare l'inventario a tue spese, come indicato nel nostro Contratto di Business Solutions di Amazon Services.  Bonjour Weihai EU,
 Certaines de vos mises en vente ont été désactivées, car vos produits ne respectaient pas des exigences de conformité obligatoires. Consultez les détails et les étapes suivantes ci-dessous. Les produits mis en vente concernés figurent à la fin de cet e-mail.
 Pourquoi cela se produit-il ?
 Nous prenons cette mesure, car ces produits ne présentent pas les informations de conformité obligatoires. Consultez notre page d’aide Sécurité et conformité des produits pour obtenir des informations sur les lois, réglementations et politiques Amazon applicables. Nous nous sommes appuyés sur une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles menés par des personnes expérimentées pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.
 Le tableau situé à la fin de cet e-mail présente les exigences de conformité spécifiques aux produits.
 Comment réactiver mes produits mis en vente ?
 Pour fournir les informations de conformité requises, accédez à la page État du compte et localisez les demandes de conformité des produits :
-
 Si vous disposez des documents requis, suivez les instructions pour soumettre vos documents de conformité. Nous rétablirons uniquement les produits répondant aux exigences de conformité.
-
 Si vous pensez que vos produits sont exemptés de ces exigences, soumettez des pièces justificatives prouvant les raisons pour lesquelles ils ne sont pas soumis à ces exigences de conformité.
 Pour des instructions détaillées, consultez la page d’aide Soumettre des documents de conformité ou contester une demande de documents .
 Pour éviter toute perturbation supplémentaire de votre compte, clôturez ou supprimez tous les produits mis en vente non conformes que vous n’avez pas l’intention de vendre ou de contester.
 Que se passe-t-il si je ne prends pas ces mesures ?
 Si vous ne fournissez pas les informations de conformité requises, les ASIN concernés resteront désactivés jusqu’à ce que les demandes de conformité soient traitées par vous ou un autre partenaire de vente ayant mis en vente le produit.
 Que va-t-il advenir du stock Expédié par Amazon de ces produits ?
 Vous devez prélever ces produits de nos centres de distribution dans les 30 jours suivant cette notification. Si ce n’est pas le cas, nous procèderons à la mise au rebut du stock à vos frais, comme stipulé dans notre Contrat Amazon Services Business Solutions. Découvrez comment prélever du stock sur la page d’aide Prélever du stock .
 Nous sommes là pour vous aider.
 Pour en savoir plus, regardez notre vidéo Introduction à la sécurité et à la conformité sur Seller University
 Si vous avez d’autres questions, soumettez une demande dans votre Tableau de bord, dans l’onglet État du compte .

Les jouets sont considérés comme des « jouets pour enfants » sur la base des critères suivants :
Selon la classification par âge figurant sur l’emballage, le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant âgé au plus de 14 ans.
Le produit est présenté dans son emballage, son présentoir, sa promotion ou sa publicité comme étant adapté à un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.
Les consommateurs reconnaissent généralement que le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.

 Para continuar remitiendo envíos, retira el inventario o aumenta las ventas para crear espacio en tus límites de capacidad. Ve a Administrar todo el inventario para revisar las acciones recomendadas.

Amazon Services
 96
 Updates to Supply Chain by Amazon, shipment of dangerous goods, Global Warehousing, Seller Assistant, and more.
 Our Seller Newsletter provides the most important policy, tool, and program updates from the past month. Stay informed about selling on Amazon.
 Supply Chain by Amazon is evolving into Amazon Supply Chain Services
 We're extending our full portfolio of freight, distribution, fulfillment, and parcel shipping solutions to businesses of all types and sizes, including those that operate beyond our store. Read more .
 You can ship dangerous goods with our Partnered Carrier program
 As of April 30, 2026, dangerous goods, or hazmat, can be shipped domestically in the US through our Partner Carrier program. Previously, the Partner Carrier program only allowed certain lithium battery products to be shipped. Now the program is expanding to all FBA-eligible dangerous goods. Read more .
 Global Warehousing & Distribution is now available in Shenzhen, China
 You can now store your inventory in bulk at a lower cost in our new Global Warehousing & Distribution (GWD) facility in Shenzhen, China, and seamlessly replenish to our US fulfillment network when needed. Read more .
 Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfilment Shopify app is live in Europe, Japan, and Canada
 Our Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) Shopify app is now also available to sellers in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Japan, and Canada to fulfil your Shopify orders using your existing Amazon inventory. By using a single pool of Amazon inventory across all your sales channels, you can simplify operations without investing in additional fulfillment infrastructure. Read more .
 Get trademark support for your brand with IP Accelerator
 Establishing your intellectual property (IP) can help you set up and run your storefront more quickly. If you're looking to secure your trademark and enroll in Brand Registry faster, our IP Accelerator program can help. The program connects you with a network of vetted legal service providers that offer trademark support. Read more .
 Understand VAT registration when expanding to EU stores
 If you want to sell in our EU stores, you need to understand your VAT (Value-Added Tax) obligation. VAT is a consumption tax applied to most goods and services sold within the EU. If you sell products in any European country, you will likely need to register for VAT in each country where you sell. Read more .
 Check review sharing eligibility with Seller Assistant
 On January 7, 2026, we announced that reviews will only be shared between product variations with minor differences that don’t affect functionality, such as color, pattern, or pack quantity. To provide you with more clarity on how this policy update applies to your products, now you can ask Seller Assistant which of your product variations are eligible for review sharing. Read more .
 Upload your seller certifications to reach B2B buyers
 Displaying your certifications on Amazon Business can help you reach more business buyers and grow your B2B sales. In 2025, customers with buying policies that prefer sellers with certifications spent over $450 million with sellers who displayed their certifications. Read more .
 Identify untapped product opportunities with Discover Unmet Demand
 Product Opportunity Explorer now includes Discover Unmet Demand, a feature that helps you identify market opportunities with lower conversion rates. This feature is available to Professional sellers worldwide based on US store insights. Read more .
 Save your spot for the Seller Growth Summit on July 16
 Register now for the Seller Growth Summit on July 16, 2026 at the New York Marriott Marquis in New York City. This is a one-day event we've created to help you take your Amazon business to the next level. Lock in our early-bird rate of $99 before the discount ends. Read more .

 Hello,
 Your product titles are one of the first things customers see, and for customers shopping on mobile, every character counts. To ensure your product titles appeal to customers everywhere, we’re making some changes that will help you show your product name and your product highlights seamlessly.
 Starting July 27, 2026 , titles in all categories except for media will need to be 75 characters or less including spaces. This ensures that your title will fully display in mobile and is consistent with the title length used by other online stores.
 Item Highlights provides an additional 125 characters for sharing materials or recommended use cases that help customers compare options. This content is searchable and visible below titles in search results and on product detail pages.
 We’re providing you with AI-powered tools to ensure that your new titles and Item Highlights are optimal. You can start reviewing, modifying, and using AI-recommended titles and Item Highlights today by taking the following steps:
- Go to Manage All Inventory and find the listing that you’d like to update.
- Select Edit from the drop-down menu.

When changes are made to your listings, brand owners will have 14 days before implementation to review, modify, and approve AI-generated recommendations for titles and Item Highlights in Review Listings Changes .

subject: Review stranded inventory scheduled for automatic removal
body_preview:

Fix stranded inventory
 Take action to prevent unnecessary removal of your stranded inventory
 Review stranded inventory scheduled for automatic removal
 You are receiving this message because you have stranded inventory in an Amazon fulfillment center that is scheduled for automatic removal. For a full view of stranded units scheduled for automatic removal, visit the stranded inventory dashboard and sort by Auto removal date.
 Review stranded inventory
 Why is this happening?
 Inventory can be scheduled for automatic removal for a variety of reasons. In this case, the reason is that the inventory is stranded. Stranded inventory is inventory without a buyable offer and requires you to either reactivate the listing or remove the inventory.
 What happens if I don't take action?
 Your stranded inventory will be returned or disposed of based on the settings you selected on "Fix stranded inventory". To customize your settings, go to Fix stranded inventory and select Edit automatic action settings.
 If you need more time to appeal or fix a stranded inventory issue, go to Fix stranded inventory and select Delay auto removal for 30 days from the drop-down menu for each listing.

 Pourquoi cela se produit
 Nous ne disposons pas d’informations suffisantes concernant les matières dangereuses pour classer correctement le ou les produits ci-dessus. Celui-ci ou ceux-ci ne seront par conséquent pas mis en vente, et vous ne pourrez pas en expédier davantage aux centres de distribution Amazon tant que vous ne nous aurez pas communiqué les informations nécessaires. Nous vous demandons de nous fournir une fiche de sécurité (FDS) ou une fiche d’exemption (pour les produits qui ne contiennent pas de substances chimiques nocives, telles que de l’alcool, de l’acide, du sodium ou les produits qui sont, contiennent ou sont vendus avec des piles/batteries) pour chaque produit vendu avec votre offre.
 Comment continuer à vendre ces produits
 Vérifiez que la fiche de sécurité respecte les exigences suivantes :
- Être créée ou mise à jour au cours des cinq (5) dernières années
- Inclure les informations d’identification dangereuses SGH/CLP
- Correspondre à votre offre de produit :
- L’intitulé de l’offre (c’est-à-dire le nom du produit, tel qu’il apparaît sur la page détaillée) doit être identique au nom du produit qui est indiqué sur la fiche de sécurité.
- Le nom du fabricant ou de la marque de votre produit qui est indiqué sur la fiche de sécurité doit être identique à celui du fabricant ou de la marque qui est affiché sur la page détaillée.
- Inclure les 16 sections standard d’une fiche de sécurité
 Veillez à ce que la fiche d’exemption soit conforme aux exigences suivantes :
- Correspondre à votre offre de produit : le titre de l’offre (c’est-à-dire, le nom du produit, tel qu’il apparaît sur la page détaillée du produit) doit être identique au nom du produit indiqué sur la fiche d’exemption.
- Mentionner votre nom complet (prénom et nom).
- Être datée.
- Être autorisée pour votre produit (la fiche d’exemption sera uniquement acceptée pour les produits ne contenant pas de substances chimiques nocives ou pour les produits qui sont, contiennent ou sont vendus avec des piles/batteries).
- Toutes les cellules « rouges » sont remplies.
- Toutes les cellules « noires » sont vides.
 Important : des instructions complètes sur la manière de remplir la fiche d’exemption sont disponibles dans le modèle lui-même, dans l’onglet Excel « Instructions ».

Pour rappel, vérifiez que la description du ou des produits décrit correctement le ou les produits en cours de révision.
 Pour en savoir plus sur les fiches de sécurité et les fiches d’exemption, reportez-vous à la section « Renseignements et documentation requis pour les matières dangereuses » (connexion requise).

 Why this is happening
 We do not have enough dangerous goods information to correctly classify the above products, and until you provide the necessary information, the products will not be available for sale and you will not be able to send more units to Amazon fulfillment centers. We need you to provide a proper Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each product listed above. You may submit an exemption sheet only if the product does not have an SDS and does not contain any harmful chemicals, such as alcohol, acid, sodium, etc., or if the product is, contains, or is sold with batteries.
 How to continue selling these products
 Please make sure the SDS complies with the following requirements:
- Created or updated within the last five years
- Include new GHS / CLP hazard identification information
- Includes all 16 standard SDS sections
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Matches the manufacturer or brand name displayed on the product detail page
 Please make sure the exemption sheet complies with the following requirements:
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Includes your full name (first and last)
- Includes the current date
- Is allowed for your product (exemption sheets will only be accepted for products without harmful chemicals or products that are, contain, or are sold with batteries)
- Contains all required information (ensure all red cells are filled in and black cells are left blank)
 Important : Complete instructions on how to fill out the exemption sheet are available in the template itself within the Instructions tab.
 Once your document (SDS or exemption sheet) is ready, please submit it through the Seller Central upload page .
 When the proper information has been provided, the review process generally takes four business days. You will receive a notification of the results when the review is complete. As a friendly reminder, please make sure the title, product description and bullet points adequately and fully describe the product under review, and clearly list out all items sold with it (for example, a TV and its remote).
 For more information on SDS and exemption sheets, refer to Required dangerous good information and documentation .
 All sellers are responsible for ensuring that products sent to Amazon fulfillment centers comply with FBA policies and any legal requirements regarding dangerous goods, even if they are not currently restricted by FBA.

- Find ways to improve customer experience

 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service. Plus, maintaining less than a 95% VTR is part of the eligibility criteria for free CSBA coverage.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .

 Customer Service by Amazon fees .

- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf

Amazon Services
 96
 Update VAT registration information to reinstate Inventory and FBA functionality of your Amazon.it store
 Hello,
 Your Amazon.it selling account is undergoing temporary inventory and FBA restrictions in Italy because we require you to provide a valid VAT registration number in Italy.
 Continue shipping orders and responding to customers to avoid further impact to your account. Review the details and next steps below.
 Why is this happening?
 We are taking this action because you have not provided or updated your VAT registration information in Seller Central or with respective Tax Authorities as required by Amazon's European VAT registration requirements. You must provide valid VAT registration numbers for all countries where you have VAT registration obligations, including countries where you store inventory through FBA. Your VAT registration number will only be considered valid when your legal name and address in Seller Central matches the information registered in Tax Authorities databases, and it must be activated for intra-EU transactions (VIES VAT number).
 To learn more visit our
 European VAT registration requirements help page.
 How do I restore inventory and FBA functionality?
To restore the inventory and FBA functionality of your account in Italy, you must resolve the violations mentioned above by following these steps:
 Sign in to Seller Central and click on top-right button Settings > Tax Settings >
 Add VAT numbers
 Review your VAT registration numbers for all applicable countries
 Verify your legal name and address match the information registered with tax authorities
 Update any mismatched information in Seller Central
 Ensure your VAT number is activated for intra-EU transactions (valid VIES VAT number)
 What if this was sent in error?
 If you believe your VAT information is correct and this decision was made in error, you can send an appeal.
 Provide documentation from your respective tax authority proving you have requested a valid EU VAT registration certificate or that you are in the process of getting your VAT registration number by providing VAT registration application form.
 What happens if I don't take action?
 If you don't resolve these violations, your temporary inventory and FBA restrictions will remain in place. Your account will continue to be restricted from receiving new inventory shipments and creating new FBA listings in Italy.
